messages.subject: Re: Error installing rhbase1.1.1
parts:
The error is indicating that it can't find libthrift-0.8.so     Are you sure that libthrift-0.8.so is in /usr/lib, and that /usr/lib is on your PATH?

On Thursday, April 4, 2013 9:10:07 PM UTC-7, Nita Goyal wrote:

I get the following error - 
" unable to load shared object '/usr/lib64/R/library/rhbase/libs/rhbase.so'" 
while installing the rhbase package.

Thrift is installed and started properly as per the instructions on - https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki/rhbase 
I have checked the PKG_CONFIG_PATH as well as copied libthrift-0.8.0.so to /usr/lib/

I am using thrift 0.8.0, hbase 0.90.6 cdh3, R 2.15.1 on CentOS (release 6.3)

Suggestions?

I have also added a comment to issue #140 on github:  https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/issues/140
